fields.Name: T103 - Dashboards Browser Loads
fields.Description: Verifies that the Data Explorer Dashboards browser loads its list/card view (or a valid empty-state) without errors, confirming the dashboards section is reachable and renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Use the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) to open the Data Explorer app, then navigate to its Dashboards section (route /app/data-explorer/Dashboards). The success state is the dashboard browser fully rendered: a list or card view of dashboards, OR a valid empty-state if no dashboards exist. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait for the view to settle, do not navigate away early.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Data Explorer Dashboards section is open, with a 'Dashboards' heading or breadcrumb visible
A dashboard browser is rendered: either a list/card view of one or more dashboards, or a clearly-labeled empty-state inviting a new dashboard
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
